synth.notes:
Two axes: ACTION1/2 move row axis A, ACTION3/4 move column axis B, ACTION5 cycles A->B->pieces; selected piece moves 3px per ACTION1-4 within the 21x21 lattice.
Each piece cell reflects across B as a visible gray reflection (skips on-axis sources and piece-covered destinations).
Step-268 repair: a piece with any cell on row A turns its whole B-mirror invisible; A- and AB-mirrors are always invisible and erase wall rings. Not a click-position rule: the run has no clicks.
Paint order is wall<reflection<piece<target. Targets under any piece or mirror keep only their centre pixel. Names rank 4-conn components by bbox and also count foreign 0-dots and invisible-mirror pixels.
Unconfirmed: target grouping (block Manhattan<=2, or a knight move when both cells are unmasked) and priority between overlapping visible and invisible mirrors.
